description: Cancels a booking at a network venue. Takes provider_id and item={booking_id}, where booking_id comes from list_current_bookings. A cancellation is reversible — the freed slot or bed can be booked again — which is why this tool is not marked destructive. If the user is not yet authorized at that venue the call returns a consent link instead. Authorization: one Telegram consent per venue, which also covers later calls.

provider_id.description: Venue id as returned by find_providers (e.g. rudko-vertebrolog).

name: cancel
